manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0092; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Let me help and Let me carry it are natural short offers of help.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian preserves let as permission/enablement in the Let me pattern.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors distinguish the selected permission sense from leave and unrelated recent vocabulary.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both learner utterances are short and controlled for A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The transfer changes the helping action from general help to carrying an object.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, construction, lexical sense and tasks align tightly.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded permission/enablement sense in Let me ... is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at the text gate.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: Persian meaning and orthography are coherent.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval.
Character and learner-role rotation are maintained.
Quality v3: dialogue exposure, duplicate scoring, safe speech equivalence and grounded story copy rechecked after deterministic remediation.
